records.finding: Manufacturer documentation explicitly lists a 12-degree horizontal reflection stage VR1-HRS and a separate 12-degree absolute-reflectance stage VR1-VWA-12. Therefore the paper's angle is not evidence that a current 12.5-degree product should be substituted.

records.finding: 36 AWG is listed as 0.13 mm conductor diameter; the ordering note maps the length suffix 36 to 1 m (40 inches). Do not infer exact lead length simply by reading the suffix as inches.
